query: SELECT rc.id, rc.name, rc.genre, rc.streamUrl, rc.metadata, ss.stream_url as ss_stream_url, ss.status as ss_status, ss.broadcast_id FROM radio_channels rc LEFT JOIN streaming_status ss ON ss.channel_id = rc.id WHERE rc.name LIKE '%HybridCast%' OR rc.name LIKE '%Emergency%';
